$comment: Claude's pre-check of the proposed labels, shown in docs/benchmark-labels-review.md to make Manas's review quicker. Not a confirmation: only Manas confirms. ok = looks right; exclude = looks wrong or unverifiable (reason given).
amazon-cart: After shows the keyboard-shortcut copy of the cart link first; the visible cart link counts too (same address).
amazon-orders: Same as cart: shortcut copy listed, visible 'Returns & Orders' link counts too.
bestbuy-search: After 'not found' is probably the search box being drawn by scripts, not a real removal.
costco-sign-in: 'Sign In / Register' → 'Sign In or Register' (after copy listed is in the footer).
costco-deals: 'Deals' link → 'Deals' menu button, same header slot.
costco-search: After 'not found' is probably script-drawn, not a real removal.
homedepot-help: 'Help & FAQs' → 'Customer Service Center', same link target.
homedepot-deals: Can't tell if the weekly ad really left the home page or is script-drawn.
macys-help: Both open the Customer Service menu; moved from footer to header.
macys-search: After 'not found' is probably script-drawn, not a real removal.
target-deals: 'Deals' → 'Top Deals', same category id in the link.
walmart-deals: Proposer picked a 'Shop now' promo button, not the Deals link.
ebay-cart: Before is a cart link, after is an 'Expand Cart' menu button; unclear they are the same control.
kohls-deals: Before is 'Kohl's Coupons', after is 'clearance deals': different pages.
lowes-help: Proposer picked a store-pickup promo, not a help link.
walgreens-help: Before picked a product ('Support Wraps'), not customer service.
riteaid-search: Proposer picked 'Find Stores', not the search button.
riteaid-find-pharmacy: Picked 'Current Location', not the store finder.
ssa-help: Picked 'Apply for Part D Extra Help' (a benefit), not help/contact.
usps-help: Picked a 'Skip Help Links' accessibility link.
irs-sign-in: Moved from page body to header.
irs-apply: It is the EIN application link, the same in both.
chase-sign-in: Before picked 'Sign in for offers', not the main sign-in.
wellsfargo-open-account: Picked a mortgage 'Get started' promo, not opening an account.
bestbuy-sign-in: Newly found after the sign-in rule fix.
